Package com.example.syntaxio.model

Class Challenge

java.lang.Object
com.example.syntaxio.model.Challenge
public class Challenge extends Object
Represents a programming challenge that can be displayed and attempted in Syntaxio.

A challenge contains the prompt shown to the learner, starter code for the editor, an ordered set of TestCase instances used to check submissions, and an optional model solution that can be used after the learner has completed the exercise.

Difficulty is currently stored as a string value. Expected values are EASY, MEDIUM, and HARD.

    • Challenge

      public Challenge(String id, String title, String description, String starterCode, String difficulty, List<TestCase> testCases, String modelSolution)
      Creates a challenge with all fields populated.
      Parameters:
      id - unique identifier for the challenge
      title - short display name shown in challenge lists
      description - learner-facing prompt that explains the task
      starterCode - initial source code loaded into the editor
      difficulty - difficulty label, usually EASY, MEDIUM, or HARD
      testCases - test cases used to validate a submitted solution
      modelSolution - reference solution available after completion
